UPDATE settings SET
                cache_min_ttl               = ?,
                cache_max_ttl               = ?,
                cache_negative_ttl_cap      = ?,
                cache_capacity              = ?,
                blocking_mode               = ?,
                custom_block_ipv4           = ?,
                custom_block_ipv6           = ?,
                blocklist_refresh_interval  = ?,
                ui_theme                    = ?
            WHERE id = 1
